meta.name: e2e-testing
meta.description: Playwright end-to-end testing standards for RedisInsight: page object models, test structure, fixtures, navigation patterns, and flaky-test prevention. Use when editing files under tests/e2e-playwright/**, writing Playwright tests, adding page objects, or when the user mentions Playwright, E2E tests, page objects, or end-to-end testing.

howto.what: Claude 会遵循 RedisInsight 的 Playwright 端到端测试标准，包括使用 Page Object 模型、正确的测试结构、Fixtures 和导航模式，并避免反模式。
howto.when: 当用户提及 Playwright、E2E 测试、page objects 或端到端测试时，或编辑 tests/e2e-playwright/ 目录下的文件时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个 BrowserPage 的 page object。
为这个功能添加 E2E 测试。
这个测试应该放在 serial 还是 parallel？
say.note: Claude 会根据共享状态和操作判断分组。

howto.what_en: Claude will follow RedisInsight's Playwright end-to-end testing standards: use Page Object models, proper test structure, fixtures, navigation patterns, and avoid antipatterns.
howto.when_en: Triggered when user mentions Playwright, E2E tests, page objects, or end-to-end testing, or when editing files under tests/e2e-playwright/.

say_en.text: Write a BrowserPage page object for me.
say_en.note: Claude generates a class extending InstancePage with navigation.

say_en.text: Add E2E tests for this feature.
say_en.note: Claude references TEST_PLAN.md and follows test structure.

say_en.text: Should this test be serial or parallel?
say_en.note: Claude determines based on shared state and operations.
